column1: # Host imports the wasm-side platform code (platform/nativeee/wasm/*.cpp) calls; not Platform:: functions. Declared in
# ps2e_seam.h, listed in seam_imports.txt, thunked and weak-stubbed like the rest (tools/gen_seam.py).

column4: graphics: a GameTexture read from its stream: header = te_gfx_texture_header, image = the GS upload packet bytes; returns the host texture handle
graphics: Platform::Graphics::ResetBuckets -- the frame's buckets start over empty
graphics: Font::Draw -- count te_gfx_text_quad glyph quads for the font page material
graphics: Font::Draw -- the text item whose glyph quads follow (its string, screen fractions, alignment): the host's text-draw census names the strings it sees
graphics: a RigidModelData's submodel packet read from its stream (the VIF UNPACKs of its strips): the host decodes it once and keeps the geometry by the model's address
graphics: the RigidModelData is destroyed; its geometry is forgotten
graphics: DrawChunkSky -- the sky (te_gfx_sky) drawn around the camera's place (a Vector4) through the RenderView

graphics: a Skin's submodel packet read from its stream (the RET tag + VIF stream of skinned batches): the host keeps the bytes (the disk manager may move the game's block) and decodes them once by the skin's address
graphics: the Skin is destroyed; its geometry is forgotten
graphics: the BlendSkin is destroyed; its parts' decoded geometry (read from the heap packets at the first draw) is forgotten
graphics: Platform::Graphics::QueuePlatformTexts -- the host fills up to max te_platform_text records (the fps counter, a mod's timer) into out; returns how many
text: Font::Begin -- 1 while the language in force reads right to left (a language mod's direction rtl): Font::Draw shapes the texts that hold its letters (te_text_shape.h)
text: the size of the language in force's own font file (a language mod's), 0 when it has none
text: the language's own font file copied into out (size bytes); returns the bytes copied
text: 1 when the shaped texts are logged (TE_GFX_DIAG_TEXT)
text: Font::Draw -- one shaped text's census (te::text::Diag in guest memory): the host prints its lines' boxes and glyphs
